_provenance.note: KAT for ProfileKeyCommitmentWithSecretNonce determinism. Rust test asserts new(profile_key, uid) == new(profile_key, uid). Go fixture stores the computed J1‖J2‖J3 output so we can assert byte-for-byte stability across refactors. Inputs: profile_key = TEST_ARRAY_32 (0x00..0x1f), uid_bytes = TEST_ARRAY_16 (0x00..0x0f). Output is 3×32 compressed Ristretto255 points.
